name: ultra-config
description: Five setting profiles in a side pane (Token saver, Fast flow, Max quality, Guarded, Autopilot): press one to see exactly what it sets, then Activate; every activation can be undone. /config rows are written the way the menu writes them; effort, subagent model, env caps and deny rules go to ~/.claude/settings.json after a backup copy.

columns.title: Pane width
columns.description: Columns asked for the docked pane in the fullscreen layout (44-100); a width you drag it to wins
